Home / About

Compassion, dedication and expertise

An advanced endocrinology centre for diabetes and hormonal disorders, led by a doctor who believes the best care starts with listening.

Her story

Dr. Akanksha Gautam

I am a specialist in endocrinology (diabetes, thyroid and hormonal diseases), trained at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh. I have over 10 years of experience in medicine and endocrinology, with publications in national and international journals.

Working at one of the country’s most prestigious institutes taught me to handle complicated cases with ease. Endocrinology keeps advancing, so staying up to date is the motto of our centre. I’m passionate about holistic, quality care for every patient.

Areas of expertise

Dietary counselling

A diet plan you can actually follow

Food is medicine in diabetes, PCOD and weight management. Our team builds a personalised plan around the food you already enjoy, and reviews it with you at every visit.
